result.narrative:
Larsen & Toubro sits in the Watch band at a score of 28.4, driven almost entirely by one news item rather than by its payment behaviour. The payment record is benign: a single open overdue invoice (12 days past due, INR 18M) on policy TCI-WT-2026-0002, with total exposure of 83M comfortably inside the current 350M limit, and the trend is described as stable. The news side tells a more mixed story - a run of positive items (a $1.57 billion AI data-centre order, stock rallies, upbeat analyst targets) sits alongside one severity-3 regulatory_action article reporting that a Karnataka minister has asked officials to blacklist L&T over delays on government works.

The Watch band placement is almost entirely attributable to that single regulatory_action article, which contributes the large majority of the weighted score versus a small contribution from the payment side. The adjudicator agreed with the band but flagged caveats: the article is a bare headline with no supporting body text, reports a political request rather than a confirmed blacklisting or financial sanction, and sits against an otherwise strongly positive news backdrop. The adjudicator also noted that the current 12-day overdue already exceeds the 6 days late seen in the one prior resolved case, so the "stable" trend label carries only modest confidence given the limited history.

The recommended limit action is to maintain the current limit of 350,000,000 across the insurer line, as the probability of default (0.1837) remains within the target appetite (0.25) and the exposure is well within the limit; no change in limit is proposed.

The score would move to Healthy if it falls 8.4 points, which would most plausibly follow from the regulatory news aging out (it currently holds the band on its own per the outlook) or a clean resolution of the overdue invoice reinforcing the stable payment trend.

judgement.bottom_line: Maintain the current 350,000,000 limit for Larsen & Toubro; the Watch band is driven mainly by one unconfirmed regulatory/political news item rather than payment deterioration, and the adjudicator agreed with the band but flagged caveats about over-weighting that single article.

lifts_it: Score falling 8.4 points to reach the Healthy band
The regulatory_action news aging out or being clarified as resolved without sanction
The open overdue invoice settling promptly, reinforcing the stable payment trend
worsens_it: Score rising 21.6 points to reach the High Risk band
Escalation of the blacklisting request into an actual regulatory sanction or contract exclusion
